title: Malmgren introduced to Putin at an arranged meeting

tellings.link_reason: Both are Malmgren's own account of being found in a crowd and introduced to Putin.

plain: Harold Malmgren, a former presidential adviser, says he was personally introduced to Vladimir Putin, the future Russian leader, before Putin was widely known. Malmgren says the person who set it up looked for him, found him in a crowd and brought him over. In one version he names that person as the Russian official Yevgeny Primakov and places the meeting in St. Petersburg in 1992. There he says Primakov told him: "This man is rising. He will soon be very important to Russia. You should know him." Malmgren tells it in a 2025 interview, as a sign of how close he was to powerful people.
